verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖੀ ਬਾਰੀਕ ਹੈ ਖੰਡੇ ਧਾਰ ਗਲੀ ਅਤਿ ਭੀੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: gursikhee baareek hai kha(n)dde dhaar galee at bheeRee|

en.bdb: The discipleship of the Guru is very subtle like a sword edge and narrow alley.

verses.gurmukhi: ਓਥੈ ਟਿਕੈ ਨ ਭੁਣਹਣਾ ਚਲਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਉਪਰਿ ਕੀੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: othai Tikai na bhunahanaa chal na sakai upar keeRee|

en.bdb: Mosquito’s and ants cannot stand there.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਾਲਹੁ ਨਿਕੀ ਆਖੀਐ ਤੇਲੁ ਤਿਲਹੁ ਲੈ ਕੋਲ§ ਪੀੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: vaalahu nikee aakheeaai tel tilahu lai kolahoo peeRee|

en.bdb: It is thinner than hair and as the oil of sesame is obtained after crushing it in the crusher with great difficulty, the discipleship of the Guru is not obtained easily.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਵੰਸੀ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਖੀਰ ਨੀਰ ਨਿਰਨਉ ਚੁੰਜਿ ਵੀੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh va(n)see param ha(n)s kheer neer niranau chu(n)j veeRee|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs are descendants of swans and separate water from milk with their beak of thoughtfulness.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਲਾ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਚਟਣੀ ਮਾਣਕ ਮੋਤੀ ਚੋਗ ਨਿਵੀੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: silaa aloonee chaTanee maanak motee chog niveeRee|

en.bdb: Like licking of the salt-less stone they pick up the rubies and jewels to eat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸੀ ਝੀੜ ਉਝੀੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh maarag chalanaa aas niraasee jheeR ujheeRee|

en.bdb: The gurmukhs repudiating all hopes and desires move on the way of detachment and tear down the veil of Maya.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਸਚ ਖੰਡਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚ ਤਖਤਿ ਹਰੀੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: sahaj sarovar sach kha(n)dd saadhasa(n)gat sach takhat hareeRee|

en.bdb: Holy congregation, the abode of truth and throne of the true Lord, is the manasarovar for the gurmukhs.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੜ੍ਹਿ ਇਕੀਹ ਪਤਿ ਪਉੜੀਆ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਹੀੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: chaReh ikeeh pat pauReeaa nira(n)kaar gur sabadh saheeRee|

en.bdb: Climbing the steps of non-duality they adopt the Word of the formless Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁੰਗੈ ਦੀ ਮਿਠਿਆਈਐ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਵਿਸਮਾਦੁ ਬਚੀੜੀ।
verses.translit_en: gu(n)gai dhee miThiaaieeaai akath kathaa visamaadh bacheeRee|

en.bdb: They enjoy His ineffable story like the enjoyment of sweets by person who cannot speak.
Through the natural devotion, the gurmukhs attain the fruit of delight.
